דַּם־הַנָּקִי is rendered attributively (rule 28), so the article on נָקִי takes the *the* standing before its own word and no *of* is written for the chain.

וְטוֹב לָךְ → *that it may go well with thee* puts the light verb's complement *well* at the head of טוֹב's unit (rule 44), the dummy subject and modal joining it, while the לְ takes the written *with*.
